63:         def on_if(node)
64:           return if node.ternary? || node.else? || node.elsif?

66:           if_branch = node.if_branch
67:           return if use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(node.condition, if_branch)
68:           return unless offending_branch?(node, if_branch)

70:           message = format(MSG, conditional_type: node.keyword)
71:           add_offense(if_branch.loc.keyword, message: message) do |corrector|

78:         def use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(condition, if_branch)

85:         def assigned_variables(condition)

93:         def offending_branch?(node, branch)

97:             !branch.else? &&
98:             !branch.ternary? &&

159:         def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)
160:           # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens
161:           # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,
162:           #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.
163:           node_to_check = condition&.block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition
164:           return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)

166:           if condition.call_type?

171:             corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')

176:           condition = if_branch.condition
177:           corrector.insert_before(condition,

185:         def correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
186:           comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[if_branch].select do |comment|
187:             comment.loc.line < if_branch.condition.first_line
188:           end
189:           comment_text = comments.map(&:text).join("\n") << "\n"

194:         def correct_outer_condition(corrector, condition)
195:           return unless require_parentheses?(condition)
196: 
197:           end_pos = condition.loc.selector.end_pos
198:           begin_pos = condition.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos
199:           return if end_pos > begin_pos

202:           corrector.remove(range)

207:         def insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
208:           condition = node.condition
209: 
210:           if (condition.send_type? && condition.comparison_method? && !condition.parenthesized?) ||
211:              (is_modify_form && wrap_condition?(condition))
212:             corrector.wrap(node.condition, '!(', ')')
213:           elsif condition.and_type?
214:             insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
215:           else

223:           if lhs.and_type?
224:             insert_bang_for_and(corrector, lhs)
225:             corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!') if rhs

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # If the branch of a conditional consists solely of a conditional node,
      # its conditions can be combined with the conditions of the outer branch.
      # This helps to keep the nesting level from getting too deep.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     if condition_b
      #       do_something
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a && condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: true
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      class SoleNestedConditional < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Consider merging nested conditions into outer `%<conditional_type>s` conditions.'

        def self.autocorrect_incompatible_with
          [Style::NegatedIf, Style::NegatedUnless]
        end

        def self.condition_workspace
          allocate
        end

        def on_if(node)
          return if node.ternary? || node.else? || node.elsif?

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          return if use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(node.condition, if_branch)
          return unless offending_branch?(node, if_branch)

          message = format(MSG, conditional_type: node.keyword)
          add_offense(if_branch.loc.keyword, message: message) do |corrector|
            autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        private

        def use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(condition, if_branch)
          assigned_variables = assigned_variables(condition)

          assigned_variables && if_branch&.if_type? &&
            assigned_variables.include?(if_branch.condition.source)
        end

        def assigned_variables(condition)
          assigned_variables = condition.assignment? ? [condition.children.first.to_s] : []

          assigned_variables + condition.descendants.select(&:assignment?).map do |node|
            node.children.first.to_s
          end
        end

        def offending_branch?(node, branch)
          return false unless branch

          branch.if_type? &&
            !branch.else? &&
            !branch.ternary? &&
            !((node.modifier_form? || branch.modifier_form?) && allow_modifier?)
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          if node.condition.or_type? || node.condition.assignment?
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '(', ')')
          end

          if outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
            autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          else
            autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node) if node.unless?

          outer_condition = node.condition
          correct_outer_condition(corrector, outer_condition)

          and_operator = if_branch.unless? ? ' && !' : ' && '
          if if_branch.modifier_form?
            correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          else
            correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
            correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, if_branch, is_modify_form: true) if if_branch.unless?
          correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
        end

        def correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node, is_modify_form: false)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword, 'if')

          insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
        end

        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, "#{and_operator}#{replace_condition(condition)}")

          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))
          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)
        end

        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
          range = range_between(
            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
          )
          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)
          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))

          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition)
        end

        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)
          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens
          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,
          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.
          node_to_check = condition&.block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition
          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)

          if condition.call_type?
            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)

            corrector.replace(condition, source)
          else
            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
          end
        end

        def correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_before(condition,
                                  "#{'!' if node.unless?}#{replace_condition(node.condition)} && ")

          corrector.remove(node.condition)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(node.loc.keyword, newlines: false))
          corrector.replace(if_branch.loc.keyword, 'if')
        end

        def correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[if_branch].select do |comment|
            comment.loc.line < if_branch.condition.first_line
          end
          comment_text = comments.map(&:text).join("\n") << "\n"

          corrector.insert_before(node.loc.keyword, comment_text) unless comments.empty?
        end

        def correct_outer_condition(corrector, condition)
          return unless require_parentheses?(condition)

          end_pos = condition.loc.selector.end_pos
          begin_pos = condition.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos
          return if end_pos > begin_pos

          range = range_between(end_pos, begin_pos)
          corrector.remove(range)
          corrector.insert_after(range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(condition.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
          condition = node.condition

          if (condition.send_type? && condition.comparison_method? && !condition.parenthesized?) ||
             (is_modify_form && wrap_condition?(condition))
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '!(', ')')
          elsif condition.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          else
            corrector.insert_before(condition, '!')
          end
        end

        def insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          lhs, rhs = *node # rubocop:disable InternalAffairs/NodeDestructuring

          if lhs.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, lhs)
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!') if rhs
          else
            corrector.insert_before(lhs, '!')
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!')
          end
        end

        def require_parentheses?(condition)
          condition.call_type? && !condition.arguments.empty? && !condition.parenthesized? &&
            !condition.comparison_method?
        end

        def arguments_range(node)
          range_between(
            node.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos, node.last_argument.source_range.end_pos
          )
        end

        def wrap_condition?(node)
          node.operator_keyword? || (node.call_type? && node.arguments.any? && !node.parenthesized?)
        end

        def replace_condition(condition)
          return condition.source unless wrap_condition?(condition)

          if condition.call_type?
            parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)
          else
            "(#{condition.source})"
          end
        end

        def parenthesized_method_arguments(node)
          method_call = node.source_range.begin.join(node.loc.selector.end).source
          arguments = node.first_argument.source_range.begin.join(node.source_range.end).source

          "#{method_call}(#{arguments})"
        end

        def allow_modifier?
          cop_config['AllowModifier']
        end

        def outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
          node.condition.source_range.begin_pos > if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
        end

        def remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          @modifier_host = host
          @modifier_node = node
          @modifier_body = node.respond_to?(:body) ? node.body : nil
          @modifier_condition = node.respond_to?(:condition) ? node.condition : nil
        end

        def evaluate_single_line_modifier(host, node)
          remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          return false if @modifier_host.send(:non_eligible_node?, @modifier_node) ||
                          @modifier_host.send(:non_eligible_body?, @modifier_body) ||
                          @modifier_host.send(:non_eligible_condition?, @modifier_condition)

          @modifier_host.send(:modifier_fits_on_single_line?, @modifier_node)
        end

        def evaluate_non_eligible_node(host, node)
          remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          source = @modifier_host.processed_source
          @modifier_node.modifier_form? ||
            @modifier_node.nonempty_line_count > 3 ||
            source.line_with_comment?(@modifier_node.loc.last_line) ||
            (modifier_first_line_comment && modifier_code_after)
        end

        def evaluate_non_eligible_body(host, body)
          remember_modifier_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @modifier_body = body
          @modifier_body.nil? ||
            @modifier_body.empty_source? ||
            @modifier_body.begin_type? ||
            @modifier_host.processed_source.contains_comment?(@modifier_body.source_range)
        end

        def evaluate_non_eligible_condition(host, condition)
          remember_modifier_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @modifier_condition = condition
          @modifier_condition.each_node.any?(&:lvasgn_type?)
        end

        def evaluate_modifier_fits(host, node)
          remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          return true unless evaluate_max_line_length(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)

          evaluate_length_in_modifier_form(@modifier_host, @modifier_node) <=
            evaluate_max_line_length(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
        end

        def evaluate_length_in_modifier_form(host, node)
          remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          keyword_element = @modifier_node.loc.keyword
          code_before = keyword_element.source_line[0...keyword_element.column]
          expression = compose_modifier_form(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
          @modifier_host.send(:line_length, "#{code_before}#{expression}#{modifier_code_after}")
        end

        def compose_modifier_form(host, node)
          remember_modifier_context(host, node)
          body = compose_if_body_source(@modifier_host, @modifier_body)
          expression = [body, @modifier_node.keyword, @modifier_condition.source].compact.join(' ')
          parenthesized = evaluate_parenthesize(@modifier_host, @modifier_node) ? "(#{expression})" : expression
          [parenthesized, modifier_first_line_comment].compact.join(' ')
        end

        def compose_if_body_source(host, if_body)
          remember_modifier_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @modifier_body = if_body
          if @modifier_body.call_type? &&
             @modifier_body.last_argument&.hash_type? &&
             @modifier_body.last_argument.pairs.last&.value_omission?
            "#{compose_method_source(@modifier_host, @modifier_body)}(#{@modifier_body.arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')})"

        def compose_method_source(host, if_body)

          @modifier_body = if_body
          end_range = @modifier_body.implicit_call? ? @modifier_body.loc.dot.end : @modifier_body.loc.selector

            @modifier_host.class::MSG_USE_MODIFIER
          elsif evaluate_too_long_due_to_modifier(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
            @modifier_host.class::MSG_USE_NORMAL
          end
        end

        def correct_if_unless_modifier(host, corrector, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          replacement = if @modifier_node.modifier_form?
                          replacement_for_modifier_form_node(@modifier_host, corrector, @modifier_node)
                        else
                          @modifier_host.send(:to_modifier_form, @modifier_node)
                        end
          corrector.replace(@modifier_node, replacement)
        end

        def replacement_for_modifier_form_node(host, corrector, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          comment = comment_on_same_line(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
          @layout_comment = comment
          if comment && evaluate_too_long_due_to_comment(@modifier_host, @modifier_node, comment)
            remove_line_comment(@modifier_host, corrector, @modifier_node, comment)
            return compose_modifier_form_with_comment(@modifier_host, @modifier_node, comment)
          end

          last_argument = @modifier_node.if_branch.last_argument if @modifier_node.if_branch.send_type?
          if last_argument.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && last_argument.heredoc?
            heredoc = extract_heredoc_ranges(@modifier_host, last_argument)
            remove_heredoc_ranges(@modifier_host, corrector, heredoc)
            return compose_normal_form_with_heredoc(@modifier_host, @modifier_node, heredoc)
          end

          compose_normal_form(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_due_to_modifier(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @modifier_node.modifier_form? && evaluate_too_long_single_line(@modifier_host, @modifier_node) &&
            !evaluate_another_statement_on_same_line(@modifier_host, @modifier_node)
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_due_to_comment(host, node, comment)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @layout_comment = comment
          source_length = @modifier_host.processed_source.lines[@modifier_node.first_line - 1].length
          max_length = @modifier_host.send(:max_line_length)
          source_length >= max_length &&
            source_length - @layout_comment.source_range.length <= max_length
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_single_line(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          max_length = @modifier_host.send(:max_line_length)
          return false unless max_length

          @layout_range = @modifier_node.source_range
          return false unless @layout_range.single_line?
          return false unless line_length_enabled_at_line(@modifier_host, @layout_range.first_line)

          line = @layout_range.source_line
          return false if @modifier_host.send(:line_length, line) <= max_length

          evaluate_too_long_based_on_config(@modifier_host, @layout_range, line)
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_based_on_config(host, range, line)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @layout_range = range
          return false if @modifier_host.send(:matches_allowed_pattern?, line)

          too_long = evaluate_too_long_ignore_directives(@modifier_host, @layout_range, line)
          return too_long unless too_long == :undetermined

          evaluate_too_long_allow_uri(@modifier_host, line)
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_ignore_directives(host, range, line)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @layout_range = range
          if @modifier_host.send(:ignore_cop_directives?) &&
             @modifier_host.send(:directive_on_source_line?, @layout_range.line - 1)
            return @modifier_host.send(:line_length_without_directive, line) >
                   @modifier_host.send(:max_line_length)
          end

          :undetermined
        end

        def evaluate_too_long_allow_uri(host, line)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          if @modifier_host.send(:allow_uri?)
            uri_range = @modifier_host.send(:find_excessive_uri_range, line)
            return false if uri_range && @modifier_host.send(:allowed_uri_position?, line, uri_range)
          end

          true
        end

        def line_length_enabled_at_line(host, line)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @modifier_host.processed_source.comment_config.cop_enabled_at_line?('Layout/LineLength', line)
        end

        def evaluate_named_capture(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @modifier_node.condition.match_with_lvasgn_type?
        end

        def evaluate_non_simple_if_unless(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @modifier_node.ternary? || @modifier_node.elsif? || @modifier_node.else?
        end

        def evaluate_another_statement_on_same_line(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          line_no = @modifier_node.source_range.last_line
          current = @modifier_node
          while current && !current.begin_type?
            index = current.sibling_index
            current = current.parent
          end

          current && (sibling = current.children[index + 1]) && sibling.source_range.first_line == line_no
        end

        def compose_normal_form(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          indentation = @modifier_host.send(:indent, @modifier_node)
          <<~RUBY.chomp
            #{@modifier_node.keyword} #{@modifier_node.condition.source}
            #{indentation}  #{@modifier_node.body.source}
            #{indentation}end
          RUBY
        end

        def compose_normal_form_with_heredoc(host, node, heredoc)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          indentation = @modifier_host.send(:indent, @modifier_node)
          heredoc_body, heredoc_end = heredoc
          <<~RUBY.chomp
            #{@modifier_node.keyword} #{@modifier_node.condition.source}
            #{indentation}  #{@modifier_node.body.source}
            #{indentation}  #{heredoc_body.source.chomp}
            #{indentation}  #{heredoc_end.source.chomp}
            #{indentation}end
          RUBY
        end

        def compose_modifier_form_with_comment(host, node, comment)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @layout_comment = comment
          indentation = @modifier_host.send(:indent, @modifier_node)
          <<~RUBY.chomp
            #{@layout_comment.source}
            #{indentation}#{@modifier_node.body.source} #{@modifier_node.keyword} #{@modifier_node.condition.source}
          RUBY
        end

        def extract_heredoc_ranges(host, last_argument)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          [last_argument.loc.heredoc_body, last_argument.loc.heredoc_end]
        end

        def remove_heredoc_ranges(host, corrector, heredoc)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          heredoc.each do |range|
            corrector.remove(@modifier_host.send(:range_by_whole_lines, range, include_final_newline: true))
          end
        end

        def comment_on_same_line(host, node)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @layout_comment = @modifier_host.processed_source.comments.find do |comment|
            @modifier_host.send(:same_line?, comment, @modifier_node)
          end
        end

        def remove_line_comment(host, corrector, node, comment)
          remember_layout_context(host, node)
          @layout_comment = comment
          corrector.remove(
            @modifier_host.send(
              :range_with_surrounding_space,
              range: @layout_comment.source_range,
              side: :left
            )
          )
        end

        def evaluate_defined_nodes(host, condition)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          @layout_range = condition.source_range if condition.respond_to?(:source_range)
          if condition.defined_type?
            [condition]
          else
            condition.each_descendant.select(&:defined_type?)
          end
        end

        def evaluate_defined_argument_undefined(host, if_node, defined_node)
          remember_layout_context(host, if_node)
          defined_argument = defined_node.first_argument
          return false unless defined_argument.lvar_type? || defined_argument.send_type?

          @modifier_node.left_siblings.none? do |sibling|
            sibling.respond_to?(:lvasgn_type?) && sibling.lvasgn_type? &&
              sibling.name == defined_argument.node_parts[0]
          end
        end

        def evaluate_pattern_matching_nodes(host, condition)
          remember_layout_context(host, @modifier_node)
          if condition.match_pattern_type? || condition.match_pattern_p_type?
            [condition]
          else
            condition.each_descendant.select do |child|
              child.match_pattern_type? || child.match_pattern_p_type?
            end
          end
        end

        def remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_host = host
          @negation_node = node
          @negation_condition = node.respond_to?(:condition) ? node.condition : node
          @negation_corrector = nil
        end

        def scan_negative_conditional(host, node, message, &block)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          return if @negation_host.send(:empty_condition?, @negation_condition)

          condition = @negation_condition
          condition = condition.children.last while condition.begin_type?
          @negation_condition = condition
          return unless @negation_host.send(:single_negative?, @negation_condition)
          return if @negation_node.if_type? && @negation_node.else?

          host.add_offense(node, message: message, &block)
        end

        def apply_negative_condition_correction(host, corrector, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_corrector = corrector
          condition = unwrap_begin_condition_for_negation(@negation_node)
          @negation_condition = condition
          @negation_corrector.replace(@negation_node.loc.keyword, @negation_node.inverse_keyword)
          @negation_corrector.replace(condition, condition.children.first.source)
        end

        def unwrap_begin_condition_for_negation(node)
          condition = node.respond_to?(:condition) ? node.condition : @negation_condition
          condition = condition.children.first while condition.begin_type?
          @negation_condition = condition
        end

        def unwrap_begin_nodes_for_negation(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          current = @negation_node
          current = current.children.first while current && (current.begin_type? || current.kwbegin_type?)
          @negation_condition = current
        end

        def evaluate_if_else_shape(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          else_branch = @negation_node.else_branch
          !@negation_node.elsif? && else_branch && (!else_branch.if_type? || !else_branch.elsif?)
        end

        def evaluate_negated_condition_node(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_condition = node
          @negation_condition.send_type? &&
            (@negation_condition.negation_method? || %i[!= !~].include?(@negation_condition.method_name))
        end

        def evaluate_negated_if_else_message(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          type = @negation_node.ternary? ? 'ternary' : 'if-else'
          format(@negation_host.class::MSG, type: type)
        end

        def evaluate_corrected_ancestor(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          corrected = @negation_host.instance_variable_get(:@corrected_nodes)
          @negation_node.each_ancestor(:if).any? { |ancestor| corrected&.include?(ancestor) }
        end

        def correct_negated_if_else_condition(host, corrector, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_corrector = corrector
          replacement =
            if @negation_condition.negation_method?
              @negation_condition.receiver.source
            else
              inverted_method = @negation_condition.method_name.to_s.sub('!', '=')
              "#{@negation_condition.receiver.source} #{inverted_method} #{@negation_condition.first_argument.source}"
            end
          @negation_corrector.replace(@negation_condition, replacement)
        end

        def swap_negated_if_else_branches(host, corrector, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_corrector = corrector
          if @negation_node.if_branch.nil?
            @negation_corrector.remove(
              @negation_host.send(:range_by_whole_lines, @negation_node.loc.else, include_final_newline: true)
            )
          else
            @negation_corrector.swap(
              collect_negated_if_range(@negation_host, @negation_node),
              collect_negated_else_range(@negation_host, @negation_node)
            )
          end
        end

        def collect_negated_if_range(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          if @negation_node.ternary?
            @negation_node.if_branch
          else
            @negation_host.send(
              :range_between,
              @negation_node.condition.source_range.end_pos,
              @negation_node.loc.else.begin_pos
            )
          end
        end

        def collect_negated_else_range(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          if @negation_node.ternary?
            @negation_node.else_branch
          else
            @negation_host.send(
              :range_between,
              @negation_node.loc.else.end_pos,
              @negation_node.loc.end.begin_pos
            )
          end
        end

        def double_negation_condition?(host, node)
          remember_negation_context(host, node)
          @negation_condition = node
          @negation_condition.send_type? &&
            @negation_condition.method?(:!) &&
            @negation_condition.receiver&.send_type? &&
            @negation_condition.receiver.method?(:!)
        end

        def remember_nested_context(host, node)
          @logical_host = host
          @logical_node = node
          @nested_outer = node.respond_to?(:parent) ? node.parent : nil
          @nested_keyword = node.respond_to?(:keyword) ? node.keyword : nil
        end

        def check_nested_modifier(host, node)
          remember_nested_context(host, node)
          inner = @logical_node
          outer = @nested_outer
          return if @logical_host.send(:part_of_ignored_node?, inner)
          return unless nested_modifier?(inner) && nested_modifier?(outer)

          @logical_node = inner
          @nested_outer = outer
          @logical_host.add_offense(inner.loc.keyword) do |corrector|
            correct_nested_modifier(@logical_host, corrector, inner)
          end
          @logical_host.send(:ignore_node, inner)
        end

        def nested_modifier?(node)
          @logical_node = node if node
          node&.basic_conditional? && node.modifier_form?
        end

        def correct_nested_modifier(host, corrector, node)
          remember_nested_context(host, node)
          return unless @logical_node.if_type? && @nested_outer.if_type?

          range = @logical_host.send(
            :range_between,
            @logical_node.loc.keyword.begin_pos,
            @nested_outer.condition.source_range.end_pos
          )
          corrector.replace(range, compose_nested_expression(@logical_host, @logical_node))
        end

        def compose_nested_expression(host, inner_node)
          remember_nested_context(host, inner_node)
          outer = inner_node.parent
          @nested_outer = outer
          @nested_keyword = outer.keyword
          operator = nested_replacement_operator(outer.keyword)
          lh_operand = nested_left_hand_operand(outer, operator)
          rh_operand = nested_right_hand_operand(inner_node, outer.keyword)
          "#{outer.keyword} #{lh_operand} #{operator} #{rh_operand}"
        end

        def nested_replacement_operator(keyword)
          @nested_keyword = keyword
          keyword == 'if' ? '&&' : '||'
        end

        def nested_left_hand_operand(node, operator)
          @nested_outer = node
          expr = @nested_outer.condition.source
          expr = "(#{expr})" if @nested_outer.condition.or_type? && operator == '&&'
          expr
        end

        def nested_right_hand_operand(node, left_hand_keyword)
          @logical_node = node
          condition = node.condition
          expr = if condition.send_type? && !condition.arguments.empty? && !condition.operator_method?
                   nested_method_arguments(condition)
                 else
                   condition.source
                 end
          @logical_node = node
          expr = "(#{expr})" if nested_requires_parens?(condition)
          expr = "!#{expr}" unless left_hand_keyword == node.keyword
          expr
        end

        def nested_method_arguments(send_node)
          @logical_node = send_node unless send_node.nil?
          expr = +''
          expr << "#{send_node.receiver.source}." if send_node.receiver
          expr << send_node.method_name.to_s
          expr << "(#{send_node.arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')})"
          expr
        end

        def nested_requires_parens?(node)
          @logical_node = node if node.respond_to?(:or_type?)
          node.or_type? || !(RuboCop::AST::Node::COMPARISON_OPERATORS & node.children).empty?
        end

        def correct_if_inside_else(host, corrector, node)
          remember_nested_context(host, node)
          current = node
          if nested_then?(current)
            RuboCop::Cop::IfThenCorrector.new(current, indentation: 0).call(corrector)
            return
          end

          if current.modifier_form?
            correct_to_elsif_from_modifier(host, corrector, current)
          else
            correct_to_elsif_from_if_inside_else(host, corrector, current, current.condition)
          end

          end_range = nested_end_range(current)
          @logical_node = current
          corrector.remove(host.send(:range_by_whole_lines, end_range, include_final_newline: true))
          return unless (if_branch = current.if_branch)

          range = host.send(:range_by_whole_lines, if_branch.source_range, include_final_newline: true)
          corrector.remove(range)
        end

        def correct_to_elsif_from_modifier(host, corrector, node)
          remember_nested_context(host, node)
          current = node
          corrector.replace(current.parent.loc.else, <<~RUBY.chop)
            elsif #{current.condition.source}
            #{host.send(:indent, current.if_branch)}#{current.if_branch.source}
            end
          RUBY
        end

        def correct_to_elsif_from_if_inside_else(host, corrector, node, condition)
          remember_nested_context(host, node)
          current = node
          corrector.replace(current.parent.loc.else, "elsif #{condition.source}")
          if_condition_range = nested_if_condition_range(current, condition)
          if (if_branch = current.if_branch)
            corrector.replace(if_condition_range, if_branch.source)
          else
            corrector.remove(host.send(:range_by_whole_lines, if_condition_range, include_final_newline: true))
          end
          corrector.remove(condition)
        end

        def nested_then?(node)
          @logical_node = node
          node.loc.begin&.source == 'then'
        end

        def nested_end_range(node)
          @logical_node = node
          end_range = node.loc.end
          return end_range if end_range

          nested_end_range(node.parent)
        end

        def nested_if_condition_range(node, condition)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_host.send(:range_between, node.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)
        end

        def allow_if_modifier_in_else_branch?(host, else_branch)
          remember_nested_context(host, else_branch)
          @logical_host.send(:cop_config)['AllowIfModifier'] && @logical_node&.modifier_form?
        end

        def remember_logical_context(host, node)
          @logical_host = host
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = nil
          @logical_operator = node.respond_to?(:operator) ? node.operator : nil
        end

        def process_logical_operator(host, node)
          remember_logical_context(host, node)
          current = node
          return if current.logical_operator?

          message = logical_operator_message(current)
          host.add_offense(current.loc.operator, message: message) do |corrector|
            @logical_corrector = corrector
            current.each_child_node do |expr|
              if expr.send_type?
                correct_logical_send(expr, corrector)
              elsif expr.return_type? || expr.assignment?
                correct_logical_other(expr, corrector)
              end
            end
            corrector.replace(current.loc.operator, current.alternate_operator)
            keep_logical_operator_precedence(corrector, current)
          end
        end

        def process_logical_conditionals(host, node)
          remember_logical_context(host, node)
          @logical_node.condition.each_node(*RuboCop::AST::Node::OPERATOR_KEYWORDS) do |operator|
            process_logical_operator(@logical_host, operator)
          end
        end

        def logical_operator_message(node)
          @logical_node = node
          format(@logical_host.class::MSG, prefer: node.alternate_operator, current: node.operator)
        end

        def correct_logical_send(node, corrector)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          return correct_logical_not(node, node.receiver, corrector) if node.method?(:!)
          return correct_logical_setter(node, corrector) if node.setter_method?
          return correct_logical_other(node, corrector) if node.comparison_method?
          return unless logical_correctable_send?(node)

          whitespace_before_arg_range = logical_whitespace_before_arg(node)
          corrector.remove(whitespace_before_arg_range)
          corrector.insert_before(whitespace_before_arg_range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(node.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def correct_logical_setter(node, corrector)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          corrector.insert_before(node.receiver, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(node.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def correct_logical_not(node, receiver, corrector)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          if node.prefix_bang?
            return unless receiver.send_type?

            correct_logical_send(receiver, corrector)
          elsif node.prefix_not?
            correct_logical_other(node, corrector)
          else
            raise 'unrecognized unary negation operator'
          end
        end

        def correct_logical_other(node, corrector)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          return if node.parenthesized_call?

          corrector.wrap(node, '(', ')')
        end

        def keep_logical_operator_precedence(corrector, node)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          if node.or_type? && node.parent&.and_type?
            corrector.wrap(node, '(', ')')
          elsif node.and_type? && node.rhs.or_type?
            corrector.wrap(node.rhs, '(', ')')
          end
        end

        def logical_correctable_send?(node)
          @logical_node = node
          !node.parenthesized? && node.arguments? && !node.method?(:[])
        end

        def logical_whitespace_before_arg(node)
          @logical_node = node
          begin_paren = node.loc.selector.end_pos
          end_paren = begin_paren
          end_paren += 1 unless /\?\S/.match?(node.source)
          @logical_host.send(:range_between, begin_paren, end_paren)
        end

        def correct_parentheses_pair(host, corrector, node)
          remember_logical_context(host, node)
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          corrector.remove(node.loc.begin)
          corrector.remove(node.loc.end)
          handle_orphaned_comma_after_parens(corrector, node)
          return unless ternary_parent_condition?(node) && next_char_is_question_mark?(node)

          corrector.insert_after(node.loc.end, ' ')
        end

        def ternary_parent_condition?(node)
          @logical_node = node
          node.parent&.if_type? && node.parent.ternary?
        end

        def next_char_is_question_mark?(node)
          @logical_node = node
          node.loc.last_column == node.parent.loc.question.column
        end

        def only_closing_paren_before_comma?(node)
          @logical_node = node
          source_buffer = node.source_range.source_buffer
          line_range = source_buffer.line_range(node.loc.end.line)
          line_range.source.start_with?(/\s*\)\s*,/)
        end

        def handle_orphaned_comma_after_parens(corrector, node)
          @logical_node = node
          @logical_corrector = corrector
          return unless only_closing_paren_before_comma?(node)

          range = extend_range_for_heredoc_comma(node, parens_whitespace_range(node))
          corrector.remove(range)
          add_heredoc_comma_after_parens(corrector, node)
        end

        def parens_whitespace_range(node)
          @logical_node = node
          range_with_surrounding_space(
            range: node.loc.end,
            buffer: node.source_range.source_buffer,
            side: :left,
            newlines: true,
            whitespace: true,
            continuations: true
          )
        end
